description: Use this when a visitor asks when a show, parade, fireworks or character meet happens at one supported park today or within the next week. Times are usually published for today only.

date.description: Park-local date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

name: parky_get_showtimes
title: Get show and parade times
